pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:1.2: tena kho pana samayena caṇḍakāḷī bhikkhunī bhaṇḍanakārikā hoti kalahakārikā vivādakārikā bhassakārikā saṃghe adhikaraṇakārikā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:1.3: thullanandā bhikkhunī tassā kamme kayiramāne te paṭikkosati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:1.4: tena kho pana samayena thullanandā bhikkhunī gāmakaṃ agamāsi, kenacideva karaṇīyena.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:1.6: thullanandā bhikkhunī pakkantāti caṇḍakāḷiṃ bhikkhuniṃ āpattiyā adassane ukkhipi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:1.7: thullanandā bhikkhunī gāmake taṃ karaṇīyaṃ tīretvā punadeva sāvatthiṃ paccāgacchi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:1.8: caṇḍakāḷī bhikkhunī thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā āgacchantiyā neva āsanaṃ paññāpesi na pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakaṭhalikaṃ upanikkhipi. na paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesi na pānīyena āpucchi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:1.10: “kissa tvaṃ ayye mayi āgacchantiyā neva āsanaṃ paññāpesi na pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakaṭhalikaṃ upanikkhipi, na paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesi, na pānīyena āpucchī”ti
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:1.11: evaṃ hetaṃ ayye hoti. yathā taṃ anāthāyāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:1.14: ayaṃ anāthā appaññātā natthi imissā koci paṭivattāti āpattiyā adassane ukkhipiṃsūti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:1.16: bālā etā avyattā etā, netā jānanti kammaṃ vā kammadosaṃ vā kammavipattiṃ vā kammasampattiṃ vā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:1.17: mayaṃ kho jānāma kammampi kammadosampi kammavipattimpi kammasampattimpi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:1.18: mayaṃ kho akataṃ vā kammaṃ kāreyyāma kataṃ vā kammaṃ kopeyyāmāti lahuṃ lahuṃ bhikkhunisaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā caṇḍakāḷiṃ bhikkhuniṃ osāresi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:1.19: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:1.20: “kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ bhikkhuniṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anapaloketvā kārakasaṅghaṃ anaññāya gaṇassa chandaṃ osāressatī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:1.21: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ bhikkhuniṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anapaloketvā kārakasaṅghaṃ anaññāya gaṇassa chandaṃ osāresīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:1.24: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ bhikkhuniṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anapaloketvā kārakasaṅghaṃ anaññāya gaṇassa chandaṃ osāressati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:1.26: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:1.27.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ bhikkhuniṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anapaloketvā kārakasaṅghaṃ anaññāya gaṇassa chandaṃ osāreyya, ayampi bhikkhunī paṭhamāpattikaṃ dhammaṃ āpannā nissāraṇīyaṃ saṅghādisesa”nti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:2.1.8: āpattiyā adassane vā appaṭikamme vā appaṭinissagge vā ukkhittā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:2.1.17: osāressāmīti gaṇaṃ vā pariyesati, sīmaṃ vā sammannati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss4:2.1.18: ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ dvīhi kammavācāhi thullaccayā kammavācāpariyosāne āpatti saṅghādisesassa.
